Bike has a flywheel, adjustable seat (red padded) and handlebars, a small water bottle in a holder, and a resistance knob at the front.

Image is overlaid with a marketing graphic listing generic health benefits (weight loss, better sleep, more energy, lower blood pressure, stronger immune system, lower stress, better mood, improved memory) with icons.
A 'ROYALSS STORE' watermark and logo appear across the image, suggesting this may be a stock/promotional photo rather than a photo of the actual unit being sold.

No close-up of the resistance mechanism, pedals, crank, or frame welds is provided.

risks.risk: Photo may be a stock/catalog image rather than the actual item for sale (watermark, outdoor staged setting, no other angles).

risks.if_unproven: priced as if item condition is unknown/unverified, treated conservatively as a generic used unit

risks.risk: Resistance/flywheel mechanism may be loose, noisy, or non-functional.

risks.risk: Frame or welds may have rust, cracks, or instability not visible in this single wide shot.

Video clip of the bike being pedaled with resistance knob adjusted.
Close-up photos of frame joints, pedals, and base for rust/cracks.
Clip showing seat and handlebar height adjustment in use.
